title: Norms give invertible sheaves and sections with saturated nonvanishing loci
statement:
Let $p:Y	o Z$ be a finite surjective morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-surjective-morphism]. Fix an integer $d\geq1$ and maps $
u_V:\Gamma(p^{-1}V,\mathcal O_Y)	o\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_Z)$ for all open $V\subseteq Z$, compatible with restriction and preserving multiplication and $1$. Suppose $
u_V(p^\sharp a)=a^d$ for every $a\in\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_Z)$, and that $b(y)=0$ implies $
u_V(b)(p(y))=0$ for every $b\in\Gamma(p^{-1}V,\mathcal O_Y)$ and $y\in p^{-1}V$, where values are in residue fields [def-weil-residue-field]. For every invertible $\mathcal O_Y$-module $M$ [def-sc-invertible-module] there is an invertible $\mathcal O_Z$-module $N$ such that for every $n\geq1$ and $s\in\Gamma(Y,M^{\otimes n})$ there is $t\in\Gamma(Z,N^{\otimes n})$ satisfying $$Z_t=Z\setminus p(Y\setminus Y_s)=\{z\in Z:\ p^{-1}(\{z\})\subseteq Y_s\}.$$ The tensor powers and nonvanishing opens $Y_s,Z_t$ have the meaning of [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]; no ampleness of $M$ is assumed.
